therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: modulation of dopaminergic and serotonergic neurotransmission
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with persistent negative symptoms of schizophrenia
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in NSA scale total score at Day 182

results.effect_size: Asenapine: -9.7, Olanzapine: -9.2 (change from baseline in NSA total score)
safety_signals: Asenapine associated with no mean weight gain (0.0 kg) vs olanzapine (+2.6 kg, p<0.0001)
Serious adverse events were rare and distributed across both arms
Asenapine arm: cholecystitis chronic, cholelithiasis, porcelain gallbladder, bronchitis, cellulitis (each n=1/244)
Olanzapine arm: pancytopenia, atrial fibrillation, ventricular extrasystoles, pyrexia, Clostridium difficile colitis (each n=1/224)

dose_info.schedule: Asenapine: twice daily sublingually; Olanzapine: once daily by mouth
